simple.summary: עֶבֶד מֶלֶךְ (ʻEbed Melek) means Ebed-Melek , a eunuch of Zedekeah First listed occurrence: Jer 38 7.

definitions.full: H5663. Ebed Melek מֶ֫לֶךְ עֶ֫בֶד proper name, masculine (= servant of the king , or < of (god) Melek , compare Gray Prop. N. 117, 147 ff. ); — Ethiopian official of Zedekiah Jer 38:7-8 , 10 , 11 , 12 ; 39:16 ; ᵐ5 Αβδεμελεχ .
definitions.rootNote: from 5650 and 4428 ; servant of a king ;
